answer: Single-bounty task IDs make rewards follow completed work. For a task classifying quartz in a mesa or ocean sample, a verifier checks the fixed specification and marks that ID paid after one valid result. Rephrasing it under N accounts cannot reopen payment: the same completed task set earns the same total, while extra submissions cost processing effort. This requires reliable verification, duplicate-task detection and no signup bonuses. It prevents duplicate payouts, not bots winning genuine new tasks.
